title: Product biased-sign measure
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $p\in[0,1]$. On the sign set $[0m\{-1,1\}$, take the probability law that assigns probability $p$ to $-1$ and probability $1-p$ to $1$. The measure associated with its $n$-fold independent product distribution equals the product measure whose coordinate marginals are this same sign law.
